question: According to Table 1, what volatile matter (Vad) and fixed carbon (FCad) does the acid-washed sawdust (SD) have?
rendered: According to Table 1, the acid-washed sawdust (SD) has a volatile matter (Vad) of 4.39 wt% and a fixed carbon (FCad) of 4.06 wt%.
